resources.string: HDR interface
Automatic follows HDR playback, Always HDR forces it on a capable display, and Always SDR turns it off.

Always HDR

SDR video to HDR
Shows eligible SDR video as HDR on an HDR10 display; Media3 and VLC up to Full HD at 60 fps, no Dolby Vision.

Automatic or manual 300–600 nits. Reported display limits still apply; actual brightness depends on the TV.
